description: This header file defines the interface for a message handling library in C, including functions for creating, cloning, converting, and accessing message data structures related to RT (real-time) messaging. It provides APIs to manage message serialization, deserialization, memory management, and data field manipulations such as strings, binary data, integers, doubles, and nested messages.

methods.name: rtMessage_Create
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new rtMessage object.

methods.name: rtMessage_Clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of a given message by copying its data fields.

methods.name: rtMessage_FromBytes
methods.description: Creates a message from a byte buffer.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArray
methods.description: Retrieves the byte representation of a message.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToByteArrayWithSize
methods.description: Retrieves the byte representation of a message with suggested buffer size.

methods.name: rtMessage_FreeByteArray
methods.description: Frees a byte buffer obtained from message serialization.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetString
methods.description: Adds a string field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddString
methods.description: Adds a string element to an array within the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddBinaryData
methods.description: Adds binary data to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_AddMessage
methods.description: Adds a nested message to the current message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetArrayLength
methods.description: Retrieves the length of an array field within the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringItem
methods.description: Retrieves a string item from an array within the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessageItem
methods.description: Retrieves a message item from an array within the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetInt32
methods.description: Adds an integer field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetDouble
methods.description: Adds a double-precision floating point field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetMessage
methods.description: Adds a nested message as a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetString
methods.description: Retrieves a string field value.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBinaryData
methods.description: Retrieves binary data from a field.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string field value with buffer size parameter.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetInt32
methods.description: Retrieves an int32 field value.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetDouble
methods.description: Retrieves a double field value.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetMessage
methods.description: Retrieves a nested message field.

methods.name: rtMessage_ToString
methods.description: Converts the message to a human-readable string.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetSendTopic
methods.description: Gets the topic string of the message to be sent.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetSendTopic
methods.description: Sets the topic string of the message to be sent.

methods.name: rtMessage_SetBool
methods.description: Adds a boolean field to the message.

methods.name: rtMessage_GetBool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean field value.

methods.name: rtMessage_Retain
methods.description: Increases the reference count for the message object.

methods.name: rtMessage_Release
methods.description: Decreases the reference count and destroys the message if count reaches zero.
